The '''Kesmere Minor system''' was located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]], a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It shared its name with the [[Kesmere system/Legends|Kesmere]] and [[Tertiary Kesmere system/Legends|Tertiary Kesmere systems]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kesmere Minor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
